settings.title: Settings
settings.mileageDetail: Distance on this month’s claim, day by day.
settings.dayEndDetail: What was recorded, what was sent, and what is running now.
settings.assistantDetail: Ask how to do something in this app.
settings.practiceDetail: Practise a visit with an AI doctor and get feedback.
settings.productQaDetail: Answered only from your company’s approved material, with the source shown.
settings.wifiOnlyDetail: Recordings wait for WiFi. Everything else still sends.
settings.warnOverDetail: A note on home, nothing stops working.
settings.consentLanguageDetail: The doctor chooses on the consent screen, from the notices your company has published. Until an approved Hindi or Marathi notice is published, consent is in English only.
settings.liveLocationDetail: The notice, your agreement, and sharing your location during working hours.
settings.locationDetail: What it is for, and when it is taken.
settings.batteryDetail: Keep check-ins and mileage working when the phone sleeps.
remedy.consentNoticeSuperseded: The consent wording changed while you were with the doctor. Open consent again, read the current notice aloud, and ask once more.
remedy.consentCapturedInFuture: This phone's clock is ahead of the server, so the consent looks like it happened in the future. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again.
remedy.consentTooOld: This consent was captured too long ago to be accepted now. Connect and sync sooner after a visit — your manager can tell you the limit for your territory.
remedy.recordingInFuture: This phone's clock is ahead of the server, so the recording looks like it happened in the future. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again — the recording itself is fine.
remedy.recordingTooOld: This recording was made too long ago to be accepted now, and waiting will not change that. Connect and sync sooner after a visit — your manager can tell you the limit for your territory.
remedy.fieldEventInFuture: This phone's clock is ahead of the server, so the check-in or check-out looks like it happened in the future. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again — the visit itself is fine.
remedy.checkOutBeforeCheckIn: The check-out is timed before the check-in, so the phone's clock changed during the visit. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again.
remedy.workDayClosed: You ended your working day for this date, so nothing more can be checked in on it. If this visit really happened that day, ask your manager to reopen the day — then send again.
remedy.workDayHasOpenVisit: A visit is still checked in. Check out of it, then end your day again.
remedy.ucpmpSampleCapExceeded: This would go past the UCPMP limit for this doctor this month. Do not hand anything else over — speak to your manager first.
remedy.outsideShiftWindow: This was recorded outside your territory’s working hours. If the hours are wrong, your manager can change them.
remedy.shiftWindowNotConfigured: Your territory has no working hours set, so nothing can be recorded against it yet. Your manager or an administrator has to set them.
remedy.fallback: The server refused this without a reason the app can show. Report the code below to support.
errors.sessionExpiredDetail: Sign out and sign in again from Me to bring this up to date.
errors.signInExpired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign out and sign in again from Me.
errors.notPermitted: Your account can’t open this. If you think it should, tell your manager.
errors.turnedDown: This was turned down. If it keeps happening, tell your manager.
errors.noSignal: No signal, or the server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ourSide: Something went wrong on our side. Try again — if it keeps happening, tell your manager.
sync.queueUnreadable: This app could not read your queue, so it cannot tell you what has been sent. Nothing has been lost from the server — but nothing on this screen is confirmed either. Tell your manager if it persists.
day.noServerClock: This app has not been able to ask the server what day it is, so it cannot tell which period to show you. It will try again when you come back to it.
dayEnd.captureNote: This app only ever reads your position at the moment you press check in or check out. It has not been reading it between visits, it is not reading it now, and it will not until you press again.
dayEnd.afterEnd: When you end it, the server keeps your day as it stands and refuses further check-ins for today unless your manager reopens it.
dayEnd.serverHasDayAttended: The server has your day: {attended} of {total} visits attended.
dayEnd.furtherRefused: Further check-ins for today are refused unless your manager reopens the day.
dayEnd.endingSent: Ending your day — the server has it
dayEnd.endingSentDetail: Its confirmation arrives with your next sync.
dayEnd.endingQueued: Ended on this phone — waiting to send
dayEnd.endingQueuedDetail: It sends by itself when you have signal, after anything else still waiting. Nothing is lost.
dayEnd.startedOnPhone: Your day is started on this phone — waiting to send
dayEnd.startsWithCheckIn: It starts with your first check-in.
dayEnd.openVisits_one: A visit is still checked in. Check out of it first, then end your day.
dayEnd.openVisits_other: {count} visits are still checked in. Check out of them first, then end your day.
dayEnd.rateNote: Distance only. Your rate per kilometre is set by your company and this app has not been given it, so the amount comes from payroll rather than from here.
dayEnd.noDay: Could not confirm which day this is
dayEnd.noAccess: You do not have access to this day
dayEnd.title: {day} — that's the day
dayEnd.visitsUnavailable: Not available — the day could not be fetched.
dayEnd.allOfThem: you went to all of them
dayEnd.notMet_one: One doctor was not available. That is recorded against the visit, not against you.
dayEnd.notMet_other: {count} doctors were not available. That is recorded against those visits, not against you.
dayEnd.distanceUnavailable: Distance not available — it could not be fetched.
dayEnd.noteHelp: Optional. Your manager sees it with your day.
tracking.offCompany: Live location is off for your company.
tracking.offNoNotice: Live location is off until you read and accept the notice.
tracking.pausedOutsideHours: Live location is paused outside your working hours.
tracking.pausedDayClosed: Live location is paused: your working day is not open.
tracking.pausedBackground: Live location is paused while the app is not on screen.
tracking.active: Your live location is being shared with your company during working hours.
tracking.refusedCompanyOff: Your company has switched live location off.
tracking.refusedNoAcceptance: Your company needs you to accept the live location notice first.
tracking.refusedOutsideHours: Your working hours have ended, so your company did not keep it.
tracking.refusedInFuture: This phone’s clock is ahead of your company’s, so it was not kept.
tracking.refusedTooOld: It was too old to count as live by the time it arrived, so it was not kept.
tracking.refusedAccuracy: The phone could not tell where you were precisely enough, so it was not kept.
tracking.refusedTooFrequent: It came too soon after the one before, so it was not kept.
tracking.refusedDayEnded: You have ended your working day, so your company did not keep it.
tracking.loadFailed: Live location is off: this app could not ask your company’s server about it.
tracking.loadFailedDetail: It will ask again when you come back to the app.
tracking.noticeChanged: The notice has changed since you accepted it. Read the new version to share again.
tracking.permissionDenied: Live location cannot run: location is not allowed for this app.
tracking.permissionDeniedDetail: Allow location for this app in your phone’s settings, or stop sharing for today.
tracking.lastFailed: Your last position did not reach your company. It is not kept to send later.
data.noteTitle: This app has sent {size} over mobile data this month
data.noteDetail: That is its uploads only — not downloads, and not other apps. Nothing has stopped working.
day.zoneCaveat: Dates and times are shown in UTC. This app could not get your territory’s timezone, so a day here may not be the day you worked — in India it runs 5 hours 30 minutes behind.
sync.unsentBeforeSignOut_one: 1 thing has not been sent yet
sync.unsentBeforeSignOut_other: {count} things have not been sent yet
sync.unsentBeforeSignOutDetail: They stay on this phone under your account and send the next time you sign in here. Nobody else who signs in on this phone will see or send them.
pending.sent: Sent — waiting for the server to confirm the day
pending.heading: Pending sync
pending.lead: Day will be confirmed after sync.
today.stopsLeftDetail: No visit has started for them yet. See today’s route for who is left.
today.noPlanDetail: No beat plan came through. You can still visit anyone in your territory and it'll all be logged.
today.everyoneDetail: You went to every visit on the plan.
today.everyoneNotMet_one: You went to every visit on the plan. One doctor was not available.
today.everyoneNotMet_other: You went to every visit on the plan. {count} doctors were not available.
today.transparency: What this app records about me
today.lastSyncOtherDay: Your last sync was {date} at {time}, which was a different day. This app shows a day only once the server has confirmed it.
today.unreachable: The app could not reach the server. It will try again when you come back to it.
today.noAccess: You do not have access to this plan
today.doctorNotOnPhone: A doctor not on this phone
today.title: Today
today.dayAsOf: Your day as of {time} — not confirmed since
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use the account your manager set up for you.
me.queueUnreadable: This app could not read your queue
me.languageUnsaved: This phone could not keep your language
me.languageUnsavedDetail: It is in use now, and goes back to the one before when the app restarts. Choose it again then.
me.stillSignedInDetail: Sign out did not go through. Try again — and if you are handing this phone to somebody else, do not until it does.
today.listRebuiltBody: This was a full refresh, so anything that was removed since you last synced has simply gone rather than being marked as removed. Everything below is what the server has for you right now.
today.removedOnServer: This record was removed on the server.
today.movedTerritory: This is no longer yours. It has moved to another territory.
visit.notOnThisPhone: This visit is not on this phone
visit.notOnThisPhoneDetail: It is not in the visit list this phone holds for you, so there is nothing here to check in to.
visit.noAccess: You do not have access to this visit
visit.couldNotLoadDetail: The app could not reach the server. It will try again.
visit.notOnYourPhone: This visit is not on your phone
visit.notOnYourPhoneDetail: It may still be syncing, or it may no longer be yours. Pull down on Today to sync, and if it does not appear, ask your manager.
visit.doctorNotSynced: This doctor has not synced yet
visit.doctorNotSyncedDetail: The visit is here but the doctor’s details are not. Give it a moment and try again — nothing is lost.
visit.savedOnPhone: Saved on this phone. It will send by itself when you have signal — nothing is lost.
visit.notSentYet: It has not been sent yet.
visit.locationOff: Location is off, so this check-in cannot be sent yet. Turn location on for this app and press again.
visit.fixUnavailable: {reason} Move somewhere with a clearer view of the sky and press again.
visit.fixTimedOut: The phone could not find your position in time.
visit.fixFailed: The phone could not find your position.
visit.checkInApproximate: The clinic could not be confirmed: your phone's position was too rough to tell.
visit.checkInOutside: The clinic could not be confirmed: your phone placed you away from it.
visit.checkInNotSent: This check-in cannot be sent yet
visit.checkOutNotSent: This check-out cannot be sent yet
visit.consentAgreed: The doctor agreed to a recording.
visit.recordingNotInBuild: Recording is not in this build, so nothing is being captured. The doctor’s answer is on the record either way.
visit.recordingSent: Recording sent. It is no longer on this phone.
visit.recordingQueued: Recording saved on this phone. It will send by itself when you have signal, and is then removed from this phone.
visit.recordingWaitingForWifi: Recording saved on this phone. It will send by itself when this phone is on WiFi, and is then removed from this phone.
visit.recordingQueueUnreadable: Recording saved on this phone, but it could not be put in line to send, so it will not send by itself.
visit.recordingNotFiledNoVisit: The visit or the consent it belongs to is not on this phone, so there is nothing to file it against. The audio has been discarded. Sync and record again if the doctor is still willing.
visit.recordingNotFiledNoAudio: The phone did not finish writing the audio, so there is nothing to send. Nothing was filed.
visit.askDoctorFirstOnPhone: Ask the doctor first. Nothing can be recorded until they have answered on this phone.
visit.askDoctorFirst: Ask the doctor first. Nothing can be recorded until they have answered.
visit.doctorSaidNo: The doctor said no. Nothing will be recorded, and that is the end of it — carry on with the visit.
visit.doctorWithdrew: The doctor agreed and then changed their mind. Nothing more can be recorded for this visit.
visit.recordingQuarantined: This visit is being checked after a problem with the server’s records. Recording is off until somebody clears it.
visit.microphoneOff: The microphone is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings if you want to record with the doctor’s agreement.
adverse.title: Flag a possible side effect
adverse.whatHappenedHelp: What the doctor told you about it.
adverse.keepOpen: Keep this screen open — the flag is not saved yet.
visit.witnessedNone: This phone does not have the doctor’s answer for this visit.
visit.witnessedAgreed: The doctor agreed to recording, on this phone at {at}.
visit.witnessedDeclined: The doctor said no to recording, on this phone at {at}.
visit.witnessedNotAsked: Recording was not asked about, on this phone at {at}.
visit.witnessedAnswerRefused: The server did not accept it — see your upload queue.
